column2:
calcium(n.)鈣
(無詞性變化)
calcium intake 鈣攝取量
rich in calcium 富含鈣質
Milk and cheese are rich in calcium, which keeps your bones strong.
(牛奶和起司富含鈣質，能讓骨骼強健。)
Older women are often advised to increase their calcium intake.
(年長女性常被建議增加鈣的攝取量。)

canal(n.)運河、(體內的)管道
(無詞性變化)
the Panama Canal 巴拿馬運河
ear canal 耳道
Tourists enjoy taking boat rides along the canals of Venice.
(遊客喜歡沿著威尼斯的運河搭船遊覽。)
The Panama Canal connects the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans.
(巴拿馬運河連接大西洋與太平洋。)

canvas(n./v.)帆布、畫布、遊說
(無詞性變化)
canvas bag 帆布袋
oil on canvas 布面油畫
She carries her books in a sturdy canvas bag.
(她用一個堅固的帆布袋裝書。)
The artist spent months painting on a huge canvas.
(那位畫家花了好幾個月在一幅巨大的畫布上作畫。)

capability(n.)能力、性能
capable(adj.)有能力的
beyond one's capability 超出能力範圍
military capability 軍事能力
The new smartphone has impressive camera capabilities.
(這款新手機具有令人印象深刻的拍照性能。)
Solving this problem alone is beyond my capability.
(獨自解決這個問題超出我的能力範圍。)

carbon(n.)碳
(無詞性變化)
carbon dioxide 二氧化碳
carbon footprint 碳足跡
Planting trees helps reduce the amount of carbon dioxide in the air.
(種樹有助於減少空氣中的二氧化碳。)
Taking public transportation can lower your carbon footprint.
(搭乘大眾運輸可以降低你的碳足跡。)

carnival(n.)嘉年華會、狂歡節
(無詞性變化)
carnival parade 嘉年華遊行
Rio Carnival 里約嘉年華
Millions of people dance in the streets during the Rio Carnival.
(里約嘉年華期間，數百萬人在街上跳舞。)
Our school held a spring carnival with games and food stands.
(我們學校舉辦了有遊戲和小吃攤的春季嘉年華。)

casino(n.)賭場
(無詞性變化)
casino resort 賭場度假村
build a casino 興建賭場
Macau is famous for its luxurious casinos and hotels.
(澳門以豪華的賭場與飯店聞名。)
Residents voted against the plan to build a casino on the island.
(居民投票反對在島上興建賭場的計畫。)

cathedral(n.)大教堂
(無詞性變化)
Gothic cathedral 哥德式大教堂
cathedral city 有大教堂的城市
The ancient cathedral attracts thousands of visitors every year.
(那座古老的大教堂每年吸引數千名遊客。)
Notre-Dame is one of the most famous Gothic cathedrals in the world.
(聖母院是世界上最著名的哥德式大教堂之一。)

caution(n./v.)小心、謹慎、警告
cautious(adj.)謹慎的
with caution 謹慎地
caution against 警告不要
Drivers should proceed with caution on wet and slippery roads.
(駕駛在濕滑的路面上應謹慎行駛。)
Doctors caution against taking too many painkillers.
(醫生警告不要服用過多止痛藥。)

cautious(adj.)謹慎的、小心的
caution(n.)謹慎
cautiously(adv.)謹慎地
be cautious about 對……謹慎
cautious approach 謹慎的做法
You should be cautious about sharing personal information online.
(在網路上分享個人資料時應該要謹慎。)
The government took a cautious approach to reopening the borders.
(政府對開放邊境採取謹慎的做法。)

celebrity(n.)名人、名氣
(無詞性變化)
a famous celebrity 知名人士
celebrity culture 名人文化
Many teenagers follow the daily lives of celebrities on social media.
(許多青少年在社群媒體上追蹤名人的日常生活。)
The singer became an overnight celebrity after her video went viral.
(那位歌手的影片爆紅後一夕成名。)

cemetery(n.)墓地、公墓
(無詞性變化)
public cemetery 公墓
be buried in a cemetery 葬在墓園
My family visits the cemetery every year during Tomb Sweeping Day.
(我家每年清明節都會去墓園掃墓。)
The famous writer was buried in a quiet cemetery near his hometown.
(那位知名作家被葬在他家鄉附近一座安靜的墓園。)

ceremony(n.)典禮、儀式
ceremonial(adj.)儀式的
graduation ceremony 畢業典禮
wedding ceremony 結婚典禮
Parents proudly watched their children at the graduation ceremony.
(家長們在畢業典禮上自豪地看著孩子。)
The opening ceremony of the Olympics was watched by millions.
(奧運開幕典禮有數百萬人觀看。)

certainty(n.)確定、必然的事
certain(adj.)確定的
certainly(adv.)當然
with certainty 確定地
a near certainty 幾乎確定的事
No one can predict the future with complete certainty.
(沒有人能完全確定地預測未來。)
It is a near certainty that prices will rise next year.
(明年物價上漲幾乎是確定的事。)

certificate(n./v.)證書、證明書、發證書給
certify(v.)證明
birth certificate 出生證明
award a certificate 頒發證書
You need to show your birth certificate to apply for a passport.
(申請護照需要出示出生證明。)
Every student who finished the course received a certificate.
(每位完成課程的學生都獲得一張證書。)

chaos(n.)混亂
chaotic(adj.)混亂的
in chaos 一片混亂
cause chaos 造成混亂
The sudden typhoon threw the whole city into chaos.
(突如其來的颱風讓整座城市陷入一片混亂。)
The computer system failure caused chaos at the airport.
(電腦系統故障在機場造成混亂。)

chapel(n.)小教堂、禮拜堂
(無詞性變化)
wedding chapel 婚禮教堂
school chapel 學校禮拜堂
The couple got married in a small chapel by the sea.
(那對新人在海邊一間小教堂結婚。)
Students gather in the school chapel every Friday morning.
(學生每週五早上聚集在學校禮拜堂。)

characterize(v.)以……為特徵、描述……的特性
character(n.)性格、特色
characteristic(n./adj.)特徵、特有的
be characterized by 以……為特徵
characterize as 把……描述為
The region is characterized by hot summers and mild winters.
(這個地區的特色是夏季炎熱、冬季溫和。)
Critics characterized the film as a masterpiece.
(影評人將這部電影描述為傑作。)

chef(n.)廚師、主廚
(無詞性變化)
head chef 主廚
pastry chef 甜點師
The head chef created a special menu for the holiday season.
(主廚為假期設計了特別菜單。)
My cousin dreams of becoming a pastry chef in Paris.
(我表妹夢想在巴黎成為甜點師。)

choir(n.)合唱團、唱詩班
(無詞性變化)
school choir 學校合唱團
sing in a choir 參加合唱團
She has sung in the school choir for three years.
(她參加學校合唱團已經三年了。)
The choir performed beautifully at the Christmas concert.
(合唱團在聖誕音樂會上表現得很精彩。)

chord(n.)和弦、心弦
(無詞性變化)
guitar chord 吉他和弦
strike a chord 引起共鳴
Learning a few basic chords is the first step to playing the guitar.
(學會幾個基本和弦是彈吉他的第一步。)
The speech struck a chord with many young voters.
(那場演說引起許多年輕選民的共鳴。)

chore(n.)家務、雜事、討厭的工作
(無詞性變化)
household chores 家務
do chores 做家事
Children should help with household chores like washing dishes.
(孩子應該幫忙做洗碗之類的家事。)
Cleaning the bathroom is my least favorite chore.
(打掃浴室是我最不喜歡的家事。)

chronic(adj.)慢性的、長期的
chronically(adv.)長期地
chronic disease 慢性病
chronic shortage 長期短缺
Regular exercise can lower the risk of chronic diseases.
(規律運動能降低罹患慢性病的風險。)
Many rural hospitals suffer from a chronic shortage of doctors.
(許多偏鄉醫院長期缺乏醫生。)

chubby(adj.)圓胖的、胖嘟嘟的
(無詞性變化)
chubby cheeks 圓嘟嘟的臉頰
a chubby baby 胖嘟嘟的寶寶
The chubby baby smiled at everyone in the room.
(那個胖嘟嘟的寶寶對房間裡的每個人微笑。)
Grandma loves to pinch my little brother's chubby cheeks.
(奶奶很愛捏我弟弟圓嘟嘟的臉頰。)

chunk(n.)厚塊、大部分
chunky(adj.)厚實的
a chunk of 一大塊、一大部分
in chunks 成塊地
Rent takes up a large chunk of his monthly salary.
(房租佔了他月薪的一大部分。)
Cut the pineapple into chunks before serving.
(上桌前把鳳梨切成塊。)

circuit(n.)電路、環行、巡迴
(無詞性變化)
electrical circuit 電路
short circuit 短路
A short circuit caused the fire in the old building.
(短路引發了那棟老舊建築的火災。)
Students built a simple circuit to light a small bulb.
(學生組裝了一個簡單的電路來點亮小燈泡。)

cite(v.)引用、舉出(例子)
citation(n.)引用、引文
cite an example 舉例
cite a source 引用來源
Always cite your sources when you write a research paper.
(寫研究報告時務必註明引用來源。)
The teacher cited several examples to explain the grammar rule.
(老師舉了幾個例子來解釋這條文法規則。)

citizenship(n.)公民身分、公民權
citizen(n.)公民
apply for citizenship 申請公民身分
dual citizenship 雙重國籍
She holds dual citizenship in Taiwan and Canada.
(她擁有台灣和加拿大的雙重國籍。)
Good citizenship includes voting and obeying the law.
(良好的公民素養包括投票與守法。)

civic(adj.)市民的、公民的
(無詞性變化)
civic duty 公民義務
civic center 市民中心
Voting in elections is an important civic duty.
(在選舉中投票是重要的公民義務。)
The concert will be held at the civic center downtown.
(音樂會將在市中心的市民活動中心舉行。)

clarity(n.)清晰、清楚
clarify(v.)闡明、澄清
clear(adj.)清楚的
with clarity 清楚地
lack of clarity 不夠清楚
The professor explained the complex theory with great clarity.
(教授非常清楚地解釋了這個複雜的理論。)
The report was criticized for its lack of clarity.
(這份報告因不夠清楚而受到批評。)

clause(n.)子句、(法律)條款
(無詞性變化)
relative clause 關係子句
a clause in the contract 合約中的條款
A relative clause gives more information about a noun.
(關係子句提供名詞的額外資訊。)
Read every clause in the contract carefully before signing it.
(簽約前要仔細閱讀合約中的每一項條款。)

cling(v.)緊抓、黏著、堅守
(無詞性變化)
cling to 緊抓住、堅持
cling together 緊緊靠在一起
The frightened child clung to her mother's arm.
(那個受驚嚇的孩子緊抓著媽媽的手臂。)
Some people still cling to old traditions.
(有些人仍然堅守舊傳統。)

clinical(adj.)臨床的、冷靜客觀的
clinic(n.)診所
clinical trial 臨床試驗
clinical experience 臨床經驗
The new vaccine is still in clinical trials.
(這種新疫苗仍在臨床試驗階段。)
Medical students gain clinical experience in hospitals.
(醫學生在醫院累積臨床經驗。)

cluster(n./v.)群、串、聚集
(無詞性變化)
a cluster of 一群、一串
cluster around 聚集在周圍
A cluster of small houses stood at the foot of the hill.
(一群小房子坐落在山腳下。)
Fans clustered around the stage to see the singer.
(歌迷聚集在舞台周圍看那位歌手。)

cocaine(n.)古柯鹼
(無詞性變化)
cocaine addiction 古柯鹼成癮
cocaine smuggling 古柯鹼走私
Police found a large amount of cocaine hidden in the ship.
(警方在船上發現藏有大量古柯鹼。)
Cocaine is a highly addictive and illegal drug.
(古柯鹼是一種極易成癮的非法毒品。)

coffin(n.)棺材、靈柩
(無詞性變化)
wooden coffin 木棺
a nail in the coffin 致命一擊
The coffin was carried slowly into the church.
(靈柩被緩緩抬進教堂。)
The scandal was the final nail in the coffin of his career.
(那件醜聞是他職業生涯的最後致命一擊。)

cognitive(adj.)認知的
cognition(n.)認知
cognitive ability 認知能力
cognitive development 認知發展
Reading to young children helps their cognitive development.
(為幼兒朗讀有助於他們的認知發展。)
Lack of sleep can affect your cognitive abilities.
(睡眠不足會影響你的認知能力。)

coherent(adj.)條理清楚的、連貫的
coherence(n.)連貫性
a coherent argument 條理分明的論點
coherent plan 一致的計畫
Your essay needs a more coherent structure.
(你的文章需要更有條理的結構。)
He was so tired that he couldn't give a coherent answer.
(他累到無法給出有條理的回答。)

coincidence(n.)巧合
coincide(v.)同時發生、一致
coincidental(adj.)巧合的
by coincidence 碰巧
pure coincidence 純屬巧合
By coincidence, my new classmate lives on my street.
(碰巧我的新同學就住在我家那條街。)
It was pure coincidence that we wore the same dress.
(我們穿了同一件洋裝純屬巧合。)

collaboration(n.)合作、協作
collaborate(v.)合作
collaborative(adj.)合作的
in collaboration with 與……合作
close collaboration 密切合作
The project was completed in collaboration with a local university.
(這個計畫是與當地大學合作完成的。)
Close collaboration between teachers and parents benefits students.
(師長與家長的密切合作對學生有益。)

collective(adj./n.)集體的、共同的、集體
collectively(adv.)集體地
collective effort 集體努力
collective memory 集體記憶
Cleaning up the beach was a collective effort by the whole class.
(淨灘是全班共同努力的成果。)
The war remains part of the nation's collective memory.
(那場戰爭仍是這個國家集體記憶的一部分。)

collector(n.)收藏家、收集者
collect(v.)收集
collection(n.)收藏品
art collector 藝術收藏家
stamp collector 集郵者
The painting was sold to a wealthy art collector.
(那幅畫賣給了一位富有的藝術收藏家。)
My uncle is a serious stamp collector.
(我叔叔是個認真的集郵者。)

colonial(adj./n.)殖民(地)的、殖民地居民
colony(n.)殖民地
colonize(v.)殖民
colonial rule 殖民統治
colonial period 殖民時期
Many buildings from the colonial period still stand in the old town.
(老城區仍保留許多殖民時期的建築。)
The country gained independence after years of colonial rule.
(那個國家在多年殖民統治後獲得獨立。)

columnist(n.)專欄作家
column(n.)專欄、柱子
newspaper columnist 報紙專欄作家
sports columnist 體育專欄作家
The columnist writes about education issues every Sunday.
(那位專欄作家每週日撰寫教育議題。)
She became a popular newspaper columnist after college.
(她大學畢業後成為受歡迎的報紙專欄作家。)

combat(n./v.)戰鬥、對抗、打擊
combatant(n.)戰鬥人員
combat climate change 對抗氣候變遷
in combat 在戰鬥中
The government launched a campaign to combat air pollution.
(政府發起一項打擊空氣汙染的運動。)
Many young soldiers were killed in combat.
(許多年輕士兵在戰鬥中喪生。)

comedian(n.)喜劇演員
comedy(n.)喜劇
stand-up comedian 單口喜劇演員
famous comedian 知名喜劇演員
The stand-up comedian made the whole audience laugh.
(那位單口喜劇演員讓全場觀眾大笑。)
He dreams of becoming a comedian on television.
(他夢想成為電視上的喜劇演員。)

commentary(n.)評論、實況報導
comment(n./v.)評論
live commentary 現場實況報導
political commentary 政治評論
We listened to the live commentary of the baseball game on the radio.
(我們收聽收音機上棒球比賽的現場轉播。)
The book offers a sharp commentary on modern society.
(這本書對現代社會提出尖銳的評論。)

commentator(n.)評論員、實況播報員
comment(n./v.)評論
sports commentator 體育主播
political commentator 政治評論員
The sports commentator got excited when the player hit a home run.
(球員擊出全壘打時，體育主播興奮不已。)
Political commentators disagreed about the election results.
(政治評論員對選舉結果意見分歧。)

commission(n./v.)委員會、佣金、委託
commissioner(n.)委員、專員
on commission 按佣金計酬
commission a painting 委託作畫
Salespeople at the store work on commission.
(那家店的銷售人員按佣金計酬。)
The city commissioned an artist to design the new statue.
(市政府委託一位藝術家設計新雕像。)

commitment(n.)承諾、投入、獻身
commit(v.)承諾、犯(罪)
committed(adj.)投入的
make a commitment 做出承諾
commitment to 對……的投入
The company made a commitment to reduce plastic waste.
(該公司承諾減少塑膠廢棄物。)
Her commitment to helping others is truly admirable.
(她對助人的投入真的令人欽佩。)

commodity(n.)商品、日用品
(無詞性變化)
basic commodities 基本民生用品
commodity prices 商品價格
Rising commodity prices have made life harder for many families.
(商品價格上漲讓許多家庭的生活更加艱難。)
In the desert, water is a precious commodity.
(在沙漠中，水是寶貴的物資。)

communism(n.)共產主義
communist(n./adj.)共產主義者、共產主義的
the fall of communism 共產主義的瓦解
under communism 在共產主義下
The fall of communism in Eastern Europe changed world politics.
(東歐共產主義的瓦解改變了世界政治。)
Many people lost their property under communism.
(許多人在共產主義統治下失去財產。)

communist(adj./n.)共產主義的、共產黨員
communism(n.)共產主義
Communist Party 共產黨
communist country 共產國家
Cuba is one of the few remaining communist countries.
(古巴是少數僅存的共產國家之一。)
He joined the Communist Party when he was young.
(他年輕時加入了共產黨。)

commute(v.)通勤
commuter(n.)通勤者
commute to work 通勤上班
daily commute 每日通勤
She commutes to Taipei by high-speed rail every day.
(她每天搭高鐵通勤到台北。)
Many people commute more than an hour each way.
(許多人單程通勤超過一小時。)

commuter(n.)通勤者
commute(v.)通勤
commuter train 通勤列車
daily commuters 每日通勤族
The MRT is packed with commuters during rush hour.
(尖峰時段捷運擠滿了通勤族。)
Many commuters read the news on their phones on the train.
(許多通勤族在火車上用手機看新聞。)

compact(adj./n./v.)小巧的、緊密的、小型車、壓緊
(無詞性變化)
compact car 小型車
compact design 輕巧設計
This camera is compact enough to fit in your pocket.
(這台相機小巧到可以放進口袋。)
They bought a compact car that is easy to park in the city.
(他們買了一台在市區好停車的小型車。)

comparable(adj.)可比較的、相當的
compare(v.)比較
comparison(n.)比較
comparable to 可與……相比
comparable quality 品質相當
The new model offers quality comparable to more expensive brands.
(新款的品質可與更昂貴的品牌相比。)
Salaries here are not comparable with those in big cities.
(這裡的薪資無法與大城市相比。)

compassion(n.)同情、憐憫
compassionate(adj.)有同情心的
show compassion 表現同情
compassion for 對……的同情
The nurse treated every patient with kindness and compassion.
(那位護理師以仁慈和同情心對待每位病患。)
We should show compassion for people in need.
(我們應該對需要幫助的人表達同情。)

compassionate(adj.)有同情心的、慈悲的
compassion(n.)同情
compassionate leave 喪假、事假
a compassionate person 富同情心的人

(身高和智力之間沒有明顯的相關性。)

(她曾在日本擔任駐外記者五年。)

(那位戰地記者冒著生命危險報導真相。)
